LESSON: IMPROVISATION OF EQUIPMENT AND MODIFICATION OF FACILITIES

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: SPORTS AND RECREATION FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE
Strand: Coaching 2.2 Facilities and Equipment in Sports and Recreation Games (Football, 
Topic 2.3: Improvisation of equipment and modification of facilities
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 20

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Improvisation of equipment and modification of facilities, part of Coaching 2.2 Facilities and Equipment in Sports and Recreation Games (Football,  in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 SPORTS AND RECREATION FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE.

Key inquiry question: How can re- usable materials be used for improvisation of sports and recreational equipment?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Improvisation of equipment and modification of facilities together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Creativity and imagination: the learner creates eco-friendly sports and recreational equipment and modifies sports facilities.

● Self-efficacy: the learner manages tasks successfully by appraising created equipment and giving feedback.

● Critical thinking and problem solving: the learners analyses information for decision making appraising modified facilities

based on criteria.

Values:
● Responsibility: the learner engages in assigned roles by participating in the cleaning of the environment after improvisation

of equipment.

● Social justice: the learner fosters fairness and justice among peers when appraising created equipment and giving feedback.

● Patriotism: the learner selects options in available sports and recreational facilities in the locality.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs

● Environmental conservation: the learner contributes to efforts to conserve the environment when improvising equipment and

facilities, using eco-friendly materials.

● Financial literacy: the learner explores ways to save money through improvising equipment and facilities using recyclable

and reusable materials
